exposure: Infants born to mothers with GDM treated with diet (GDMG1)
Infants born to mothers with GDM treated with medication (GDMG2)
cohort: Pregnant women who delivered in eight tertiary hospitals in Poland in 2016
finding: The prevalence of HIP in Poland has nearly doubled in the past twenty years, and even with appropriate management, HIP is a significant risk factor for cesarean section delivery, LGA infants, and adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Hyperglycemia in pregnancy is associated with a higher rate of cesarean section delivery.
